'''Moofs''' were beasts of burden native to [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. They were used as riding mounts as well as to pull plows on local [[Farm/Legends|farms]].<ref name="RVJ">{{StoryCite|series=Star Wars (1998)|srtext=''Star Wars'' (1998)|issue1=4|issue2=6|story=Vow of Justice}}</ref>
